_doc: The Mangrove Drowner's surfaces (docs/kb/art/creatures/act2/mangrove_drowner.md). Slots are the glTF material names; write_materials.py writes assets/creatures/mangrove_drowner/materials/<slot>.tres on game/shaders/creature/creature.gdshader. bark is the twelve prop-roots, the barnacles and the trunk stump (sun-bleached bone on top, weathered timber down the arch, lacquer black and clearcoated below the waterline, by vertex colour and wetness); carapace is the Undertow-spawn core and its spawn_wound seams; mote_snag is the snagged motes held in the two drag roots' cradles (M4-CRB-002, the break parts): glimmer_held and steady (held light never pulses or drifts; it rises only once released, as VFX). Colours are palette.json swatches.
